purpose: Classify diagnostic exact contexts 2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, 24K, and 32K on the identical current-f01e AutoRound TP1/MTP1/eager/F16 identity after the parent sentinel's token-99 target mismatch. Every depth independently requires exact measurement, isolated positive drafting/acceptance, and exact equality to its frozen current-f01e MTP0 oracle; full quality and cleanup gate the one-lifetime expansion. Results are lower-grade coverage and never historical replacements.

prior_evidence.e9d_eager_mtp: TP1 eager MTP1/2/3 booted and accepted well but collapsed to roughly 4.5/4.4/4.3 tok/s; that older-image MTP1 result is not current-f01e evidence.
prior_evidence.b2dd_mtp2: The older b2dd MTP2 full arm drafted 10040 and accepted 7391 (73.6155%) and passed quality, but matched a separate-boot target oracle only 23/25; it was conservatively quarantined without causal corruption attribution and is not MTP1 or current-f01e evidence.
prior_evidence.historical_mtp1: Earlier MTP1 execution proves the recurrent shape can run, but margin/shared-baseline evidence is not valid current-f01e parent proof.
prior_evidence.external_artifact: NONE. Do not bind the unrelated llama.cpp external Q4_0 MTP artifact; it diverged from its target at token 6.
prior_evidence.known_32k_risk: The current-f01e MTP4 depth expansion killed EngineCore at 32K on the speculative-token shape assertion. This is not proof that MTP1 will fail, but any MTP1 32K EngineCore fatal is an explicit terminal classification and prevents the quality phase from being misreported.

reopen_basis: The identical f01e TP1/MTP1/eager/F16 8K sentinel passed exact measurement, isolated 61/67 accepted speculation, full quality, startup identity, and strict cleanup, but diverged from its frozen MTP0 oracle first at token 99. Its candidate hash equals the MTP2 sentinel alternate at 8K only; no other-depth equality is assumed. Coverage policy explicitly authorizes this six-depth diagnostic/per-depth classification despite the parent's non-authorizing receipt; no historical replacement is allowed.

target_oracle.gate: At every depth, all 128 candidate token IDs must equal the corresponding frozen target IDs. A cross-boot mismatch quarantines that expansion without causal MTP-corruption attribution.

quality_contract.full_pass: seven exact cases, eight-repeat one-hash determinism, 8K needle, 24 baseline comparisons, and cache zero
quality_contract.gate: The full frozen quality battery runs once after all six exact requests and must pass in full.

terminal_classification.passed-diagnostic-quality-clean-expansio: All six exact depths, per-depth acceptance, per-depth target equality, full quality, identity, and cleanup pass. The packet remains diagnostic/lower-grade and publication or historical replacement is not automatic.
terminal_classification.incomplete-depth-expansion: One or more exact-depth gates fail; retain passing receipts without promotion.
terminal_classification.quarantined-acceptance-failed: All exact depths pass but one or more isolated per-depth acceptance gates fail.
terminal_classification.quarantined-target-verification-failed: All depth and acceptance gates pass but one or more frozen target token oracles fail; do not infer causal MTP corruption from cross-boot mismatch alone.
terminal_classification.quarantined-quality-failed: All per-depth mechanism gates pass but full quality fails.
terminal_classification.failed-32k-engine-fatal: The exact 32K request fails and the same server lifetime logs an EngineCore error, fatal, death, or the known speculative-token shape RuntimeError. Preserve partial receipts, skip impossible post-fatal quality traffic, clean globally, and do not publish.
terminal_classification.unsupported: Only an exact-image explicit native-MTP unsupported line qualifies.

speculator_binding.type: native embedded Qwen MTP; no external draft model
speculator_binding.recurrent_contract: one native MTP module is recurrently reused for one speculative step

acceptance_contract.snapshot_scope: For each depth independently, counters are snapshotted immediately before and after only that exact request.
acceptance_contract.gate: At every depth: drafted delta > 0, accepted delta > 0, accepted <= drafted. All six gates must pass.
